10: The foregoing recitals are hereby incorporated by reference into this resolution, as if they were set out fully herein.
11: The Town of Clermont, Georgia does hereby impose a temporary moratorium on all annexations of any type, including commercial, industrial and residential annexations to become a part of the Town of Clermont, Georgia. The temporary moratorium shall be for a time period of 190 days from the date of passage of this resolution by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia. The temporary moratorium shall apply to industrial annexation, commercial annexation, and to residential annexation.
12: This temporary moratorium is to allow the Town of Clermont, Georgia a reasonable interim period of time, being 190 days to develop appropriate plans for development within the Town, and update the Town map and to create a balance of development within the Town between residential and commercial development in order that the Town may continue to provide high quality services at a reasonable cost.
